description_1line: Specialty chemicals company spun off from WestRock in 2016; polymer leg is pine-chemical tackifier/adhesion resins and pavement technologies in the Performance Chemicals segment, anchored at North Charleston, SC.
sources: SEC Form 10-K, Ingevity Corporation (CIK 0001653477), FY2025, filed 2026-02-26 - https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1653477/000165347726000014/ngvt-20251231.htm (Item 1)
notes: Created 2026-10-30 in integration pass 16 from EDGAR step-2 packet M2 (manifest B17). CIK 0001653477. SEGMENT BOUNDARY (stated per tasking, from FY2025 10-K Item 1): Ingevity reports THREE segments - Performance Chemicals, Performance Materials, Advanced Polymer Technologies. THIS BUILD = Performance Chemicals only (pine chemicals: tackifier/adhesion resins for adhesives, elastomers, coatings; plus the Pavement Technologies / road technologies product line, which sits INSIDE Performance Chemicals). OUT of this build: Performance Materials (activated carbon - Covington VA, Wickliffe KY, Waynesboro GA plants; recorded nowhere) and Advanced Polymer Technologies (engineered caprolactone polymers - the 'engineered polymers' line; a separate segment under strategic review for possible sale by end of 2026 per Item 1, recorded nowhere). The tasking parenthetical grouping activated carbon with Performance Chemicals does not match Item 1 and was NOT followed - see notes.md. HQ and principal executive offices 4920 O'Hear Avenue, Suite 400, North Charleston, SC 29405 per 10-K. Approximately 1,500 employees per step-1 10-K fragment. Performance Chemicals footprint contracted sharply: DeRidder LA production ceased Q1 2024 and Crossett AR production ceased Q3 2024 (own FY2024 10-K); on 2026-01-01 the North Charleston crude tall oil refinery and the majority of the industrial specialties product line were sold to Mainstream Pine Products, LLC - the North Charleston plant site itself is retained and shared under a 20-year reciprocal plant operating agreement (see site S01).
